For d>=3, the auxiliary complete d-partite graph has cycle rank g=2d(d-2)+1 and simply connected flag clique complex; every triangle generator bounds an explicit surviving 2-disk in both Y and the link nerve. This makes both gluing maps nullhomotopic, yielding the inclusion-compatible wedge of 2g integral 2-spheres. Absolute ranks rely on and agree with the published intact-complex theorem.
